player_prompt.intro:
U tsahelela papadi ya Minesweeper.
Sepheo sa papadi ke ho senola mahlaka yohle ao e seng na di mine.
Ho etsa tshwetso, hlalosa feela di koordinete tsa mahlakoreng le mahlakong ao u batlang ho senola ka mokgwa wa:
- `[row col]`: Senola mahlaka a mahlahaneng a mahlakoreng le mahlakong ao u li hlalositse.
Ka mohlala:
- `[3 2]` ho senola mahlaka a mahlahaneng a mahlakoreng a 3, mahlakong a 2.
- `[5 6]` ho senola mahlaka a mahlahaneng a mahlakoreng a 5, mahlakong a 6.
Tshwetsong ya hao ya pele, u tla senola sebaka se phahameng mahlakeng ao u a kgethile ho netefatsa tshimologo e bolokehileng.
Mohlala wa borutehong ya papadi ya hajoale o bonahatseha ka tlaase. Mahlaka a sa senoleheng a emelwa ke lechoba ('.'), dinomoro tse senoleheng di bontsha palo ya di mine tse atamelang.
Hlokomela ho se khethe mahlaka a senoleheng.
Mohlala wa borutehong ya papadi ya hajoale o ile:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ha ua araba ka likhokahanyo tse nepahetseng tsa li-square bracket.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Lintlha tsa mela le likholomo tse boletsoeng li tsoa meeling.

outcome.win: Kea le leboha, le atlehile ho tlosa boto ea Minesweeper.
outcome.turn_limit: Moeli oa ho fetoha o fihlile. U atlehile ho pepesa {percent}% ea lisele tse sireletsehileng.
